book.name: 1 Korin
book.title: Natauan babam la omirong Paulo me mai ekelesiap onim Korin

content: Kakepup la eba maagailie teip ga magaulap am Morowa na Ierusalem
Titot, tuga tiestang me miriro kakepup la miga mipamum meba mialam maun teip ga magaulap am Morowa. Okosarming uriro ubi gare tinan la masingtuala ekelesiap onim toma Galatia o uriro alang.

Ma mirier Sandeap ganam, mimi ut narit narit la agatming me miriro kakepup la miaram na ubi ming o unan wik, ga miabung nap ba meba maiot maset na luguap mim kan. Are ratmat ga na tara la eba bettang tubiat, tie eba tale mimaning ubi meba maisinming kakepup ba meba mialam toun.
Ga na tara la eba bettang mi, eba talang babam maun non teip mimi kan la eba maiteming meba maiaving uriro kamniap ming me togo Ierusalem.
Pa eba agattang leba mumuru ba meba tala ga mirie, tie eba tala ga mirie.
Paulo la namo ala magimaang ekelesiap onim Korin
Tie, eba tala na provins Masedonia, ga tubiat eba tala bettang mi. Memani, tuga agimarang gar la maionama na provins Masedonia.

Tie, atabo eba tonang ga mimi a tara ila papoi. Tale orit, atabo eba tonang ga mimi puoieng na tara o susugun ga ifif ula mamaranu leba no ba. Ga eba toagamilie ma noba pagap me urio nunumiap tung, tara la tuga tala na non pianam.
Memani, tale narung meba migimarang ga tonang ga mimi a tara ila papoi. Karuk. Leba toairang Ila Kakani, tie eba tonang ka ga mimi a tara ba ila laklage.
Pa eba tonang to na taun Efeso puoieng na la o Pentikos.
Memani, Morowa la unavo ra alang ula kanu me rulam meba maagaralie papot teip ga magaulap meba betmeng lop am Morowa. Pa non gat paga, ame papot teip la nekaromela me rulam.
Pa tubiat na tara la eba betang Timoti mi, tie alagiming ga umialeng maset abuo meba onang maset kabirana mi. Memani, ume okosar ubi ang Ila Kakani, are turuo la tume okosar.
Are ratmat ga buat minia ga mialam ibup mi ira a. Agamilie meba amung na alang a malina na dalap a ga ina gat muong toi. Memani, man auantula ga non papap meba mumaiong.
Pa aime papa buang Apolos, man tiestung maranit aime meba ala migimaang ga non papap. Pa tale naong migat meba ala titot, pa tubiat eba bat ala ga migimaang, leba tara ba ila mumuri, tie eba ala.
Non gat tiesiap la gorang o uirorot
Mimi le maset temamalienming ga dusming maranit un nagan. Mimi le maset betming gare teip o uidang, ga mimamaranim ba.
Na tara la makosarming mirier pagap ganam, tie makosarming a tavuk o na.

Ekelesiap papap tuam, amit ara gar ang Stepan la lake betmeng ekelesiap kabirana ma inamaniap onim na provins Akaia, ga maialo ninimiap maiong meba maagamelie teip ga magaulap am Morowa. Are ratmat ga tuga mangangastang dalap mi, papap tuam. Mimi le omiuluan ties maiong miro teip ga mionang mapat miro teip, ga mirier teip la mime miagamelie ga mime ubi maranit na uriro ubi.
Stepan ga Potunaio ga Akaiki la mumaio toi, ga mitara teruba la magimarung. Memani, mimi ganam la tale puoming meba mumiong toi, pa mirie naien ma teip la miagamelie meba togimameng.
Mumaio togo ga makosarmeng maset dalap tuo, ga dalap mi gat. Are ratmat ga mumuru le marakiming miriro teip ga miavim bop ma.
Ualo Paulo ties o ubonuvarap maun ekelesiap onim Korin

Mirier ekelesiap na lotup na provins Esia la maialo “la ula muru” me miun. Akuila ga Prisila ga inamaniap o lotu la mime nebola na luguan liang, mirie gat la maialo “la ula muru” maset me miun na bonim a Ila Kakani.
Mirier papap la maialo “la ula muru” me miun. Na tavuk buang teip ga magaulap am Morowa, mimi ganam narit narit le obakming kaus ga non ekelesiap.
Turuo Paulo, a kilan kan tuo omirtung urio “la ula muru” me miun.
Leba noba migana la tale naong, tie eba akaranmeng ga iouang. Ila Kakani, munang!
Ubonuvarap ang Ila Kakani Iesu le iot ga mimi.
Ga na rung le iot ga mimi ganam ira Karisito Iesu. Amen.
